project.name: clinical-trial-rag
project.description: Grounded RAG microservice for clinical trial eligibility analysis: a FastAPI service that answers eligibility questions about trial protocols and pre-screens patient summaries against each criterion, with answers grounded in verbatim, verified protocol text. Built on LangChain, ChromaDB, sentence-transformers and Pydantic v2, running with OpenAI or locally via Ollama.

nodes.name: splitter.py
nodes.summary: Section-aware, criterion-level chunker for clinical trial protocols: detects section headers, labels inclusion/exclusion sections, emits one chunk per top-level criterion and prefixes each chunk with protocol/section context plus citation metadata.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses compiled regexes for header detection and small private dataclasses (_Line, _Section) with @property accessors as an intermediate representation before building LangChain Document objects.

nodes.name: _Line
nodes.summary: Private dataclass holding one line of protocol text with its 1-based page number.

nodes.name: _Section
nodes.summary: Private dataclass for a detected protocol section with title, criterion type and lines, exposing has_body and first_page properties.

nodes.name: build_text_splitter
nodes.summary: Builds a RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter tuned with protocol-specific separators for non-criterion sections.

nodes.name: strip_context_prefix
nodes.summary: Removes the leading "[NCT... | Section]" context line from a chunk's text before it is shown to the LLM.

nodes.name: make_chunk_id
nodes.summary: Derives a stable 32-character SHA-256 chunk ID from protocol ID, chunk index and text.

nodes.name: _criterion_type_for
nodes.summary: Maps a section title to an inclusion, exclusion or other CriterionType.

nodes.name: _match_header
nodes.summary: Detects whether a line is a section header (eligibility, Markdown, dotted-numbered or ALL-CAPS) and returns its normalised title and trailing text.

nodes.name: _to_lines
nodes.summary: Flattens loaded documents into normalised lines tagged with 1-based page numbers.

nodes.name: _to_sections
nodes.summary: Groups lines into labelled sections by header detection, dropping header lines for eligibility sections and empty sections.

nodes.name: _split_criteria
nodes.summary: Splits an eligibility section into a preamble and one text block per top-level numbered or bulleted criterion, keeping wrapped lines and sub-items together.

nodes.name: split_protocol
nodes.summary: Main entry point that turns loaded protocol pages into criterion-level LangChain Documents with context prefix and metadata (section, criterion type, chunk ID, hash, page).

nodes.name: guardrails.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic safety checks for the RAG pipeline: strips prompt-delimiter tags from context, verifies that LLM quotes appear verbatim in source text, checks evidence relevance to a criterion, and hashes text for privacy-safe logging.
nodes.languageNotes: Quote verification normalises with unicodedata NFKC plus a str.maketrans character map so curly quotes and dash variants compare equal.

nodes.name: sanitize_context
nodes.summary: Strips tag-like strings that could close or forge prompt delimiters, defending against prompt injection.

nodes.name: normalize_text
nodes.summary: Canonicalises text for quote comparison via NFKC, unified quotes/dashes, lowercasing and whitespace collapsing.

nodes.name: verify_quote
nodes.summary: Checks that an LLM quote appears verbatim (after normalisation, allowing ellipsis-elided fragments in order) in the source chunk text.

nodes.name: _content_terms
nodes.summary: Extracts non-generic, non-numeric content terms with light plural stemming using the hybrid tokenizer.

nodes.name: evidence_mentions_criterion
nodes.summary: Returns whether patient evidence shares at least one content term with the criterion text, catching unrelated cited facts.

nodes.name: sha256_hex
nodes.summary: Returns the hex SHA-256 digest of a UTF-8 string.

nodes.name: hash_for_log
nodes.summary: Produces a short, non-reversible 16-character fingerprint for logging patient or user text without storing it.

nodes.name: prompt_templates.py
nodes.summary: Versioned LangChain ChatPromptTemplates for criterion Q&A and patient screening, plus helpers that render retrieved chunks and criteria as sanitised, attributed XML-like blocks with short I1/E1 labels.
nodes.languageNotes: System prompts are Python f-strings later parsed again by LangChain as templates, so literal JSON braces are written as {{{{ }}}} (double escaping).

nodes.name: format_context
nodes.summary: Renders retrieved chunks as sanitised <chunk> blocks carrying id, section and type attributes, with the embedding prefix stripped.

nodes.name: criterion_labels
nodes.summary: Assigns short human-style labels (I1, I2, E1, ...) to criteria keyed by chunk_id so models can reference them reliably.

nodes.name: format_criteria
nodes.summary: Renders eligibility criteria as sanitised <criterion> blocks using their short labels for the screening prompt.

nodes.name: schemas.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic v2 request/response models for the API (queries, screening, citations, audit info) and the length-bounded structured-output schemas the LLM must fill for Q&A and per-criterion screening.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses StrEnum for status values, ConfigDict(extra='forbid') to reject unknown fields, and Annotated StringConstraints so constrained decoding grammars bound every LLM output string.

nodes.name: EligibilityStatus
nodes.summary: String enum of overall answers: ELIGIBLE, NOT_ELIGIBLE, INDETERMINATE and CRITERIA_NOT_SPECIFIED.

nodes.name: CriterionType
nodes.summary: String enum classifying chunks as inclusion, exclusion or other.

nodes.name: CriterionVerdictValue
nodes.summary: String enum of per-criterion screening verdicts: MET, NOT_MET and INSUFFICIENT_INFO.

nodes.name: EligibilityQueryRequest
nodes.summary: API request model for criterion Q&A with a bounded query, NCT-pattern protocol_id and settings-driven top_k default; strips the query before validation.

nodes.name: PatientScreeningRequest
nodes.summary: API request model for screening a de-identified patient summary (20-4000 chars) against a protocol; strips the summary before validation.

nodes.name: CitationSource
nodes.summary: Response model for a cited protocol chunk with source, section, excerpt, model quote and verification flag.

nodes.name: AuditInfo
nodes.summary: Audit record capturing model, provider, prompt version, retrieval mode, retrieved chunk IDs, context hash and timestamp to explain or replay an answer.

nodes.name: EligibilityQueryResponse
nodes.summary: Response model for Q&A answers with status, assessment text, citations, grounding flag, safety concerns and audit info.

nodes.name: ProtocolUploadResponse
nodes.summary: Response model reporting the outcome of indexing a protocol file, including chunk/criteria counts and replacement flag.

nodes.name: CriterionAssessment
nodes.summary: Per-criterion screening result with criterion text, verdict, patient evidence, evidence verification flag and rationale.

nodes.name: ScreeningResponse
nodes.summary: Response model for patient screening with overall status, per-criterion assessments, failing/unresolved criteria and audit info.

nodes.name: ProtocolSummary
nodes.summary: Response model listing an indexed protocol's source documents and chunk count.

nodes.name: EvidenceItem
nodes.summary: LLM structured-output item tying a chunk_id to a bounded verbatim quote and explanation.

nodes.name: LLMAssessment
nodes.summary: Structured-output schema the LLM fills for Q&A: status, bounded evidence list, safety concerns and rationale.

nodes.name: LLMCriterionVerdict
nodes.summary: Structured-output schema for one criterion verdict with criterion label, verdict, patient evidence and rationale.

nodes.name: LLMScreeningAssessment
nodes.summary: Structured-output wrapper holding up to 200 per-criterion verdicts from the screening LLM call.

nodes.name: conftest.py
nodes.summary: Shared pytest fixtures providing isolated temp Chroma storage, deterministic fake embeddings, a fake structured-output LLM, a chain factory, a FastAPI TestClient with dependency overrides, and PDF/upload helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Overrides FastAPI dependencies via app.dependency_overrides inside a yield fixture so each test gets an offline, isolated application instance.

nodes.name: FakeStructuredLLM
nodes.summary: Offline stand-in for ChatOpenAI whose with_structured_output returns a runnable that parses prompt blocks and produces LLMAssessment or LLMScreeningAssessment objects, with configurable responders, rules and errors.

nodes.name: settings
nodes.summary: Fixture building isolated Settings with temp Chroma/upload dirs, a unique collection name, the relevance gate disabled and no OpenAI key.

nodes.name: vector_store
nodes.summary: Fixture creating a Chroma vector store backed by deterministic fake embeddings.

nodes.name: indexer
nodes.summary: Fixture wrapping the test vector store in a ProtocolIndexer.

nodes.name: fake_llm
nodes.summary: Fixture returning a default FakeStructuredLLM.

nodes.name: make_chain
nodes.summary: Fixture factory that builds an EligibilityRAGChain with a given LLM and per-test settings overrides.

nodes.name: client

nodes.name: app.py
nodes.summary: ASGI entry point that builds the FastAPI application: configures logging on startup, adds request-ID/latency middleware, maps domain exceptions (parser and RAG chain errors) to HTTP status codes, and mounts the health and protocol routers.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses FastAPI's asynccontextmanager lifespan and registers one shared exception handler per exception class from a status-code dictionary.

nodes.name: lifespan
nodes.summary: Async lifespan context that loads settings, configures logging, ensures data directories exist and logs the startup version and LLM model.

nodes.name: create_app
nodes.summary: Factory that builds the FastAPI app with request-context middleware, exception-to-HTTP-status handlers and the health and protocol routers.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the src package that declares the service's __version__ string used in the FastAPI app metadata and startup log.

nodes.name: routes.py
nodes.summary: Defines the HTTP API: liveness/readiness probes plus /api/v1 endpoints to upload and index protocol documents, answer criterion questions, screen patients, list and delete protocols. Handles upload safety (filename sanitization, PDF magic-byte check, size-limited staging, atomic replace).
nodes.languageNotes: Handlers are plain `def` functions so FastAPI runs blocking embedding/Chroma/LLM work in its threadpool; dependencies are injected via Depends.

nodes.name: sanitize_filename
nodes.summary: Strips directory components and unsafe characters from an uploaded filename to block path traversal, capping length at 120 characters.

nodes.name: _stage_upload
nodes.summary: Streams an upload to a hidden temp file in chunks, enforcing the maximum size and rejecting empty files, and cleans up on any failure.

nodes.name: health
nodes.summary: Liveness probe that returns a static healthy status without touching the model or vector store.

nodes.name: ready
nodes.summary: Readiness probe that verifies the vector store loads (returning 503 on failure) and reports the configured LLM provider, model and availability.

nodes.name: index_protocol
nodes.summary: POST /api/v1/protocols/index handler that validates extension and PDF signature, stages the upload, runs ingestion and atomically replaces the stored file.

nodes.name: query_protocol
nodes.summary: POST /api/v1/protocols/query handler that delegates a criterion question to the RAG chain and returns a cited answer.

nodes.name: screen_patient
nodes.summary: POST /api/v1/protocols/screen handler that delegates per-criterion patient screening to the RAG chain.

nodes.name: list_protocols
nodes.summary: GET /api/v1/protocols handler returning a summary of every indexed protocol.

nodes.name: delete_protocol
nodes.summary: DELETE /api/v1/protocols/{protocol_id} handler that removes a protocol's chunks and returns 404 if none existed.

nodes.name: indexer.py
nodes.summary: Persists protocol chunks into a ChromaDB vector store with protocol-scoped, idempotent replace semantics, and exposes reads for chunks, criteria and protocol summaries; ingest_file runs the parse -> split -> index pipeline.

nodes.name: build_vector_store
nodes.summary: Creates a persistent Chroma collection with the given embedding function using cosine HNSW distance.

nodes.name: ingest_file
nodes.summary: Runs the parse -> split -> index pipeline for one protocol file and returns an upload response with chunk and criterion counts.

nodes.name: ProtocolIndexer
nodes.summary: Protocol-scoped wrapper over a Chroma store that replaces, deletes, lists and reads chunks and inclusion/exclusion criteria in document order.

nodes.name: parser.py
nodes.summary: Loads .pdf and .txt protocol files into LangChain Documents, with encoding fallbacks for text and typed errors for unsupported, empty or unparseable files.
nodes.languageNotes: Falls back through utf-8-sig, cp1252 and latin-1 because LangChain's TextLoader wraps UnicodeDecodeError in RuntimeError.

nodes.name: _load_text
nodes.summary: Loads a text file by trying a sequence of encodings, warning on non-UTF-8 input and raising DocumentParseError if none decode.

nodes.name: load_document
nodes.summary: Validates the file extension and loads a PDF (one Document per page) or text file, dropping empty pages and raising typed errors for unreadable or empty inputs.

nodes.name: UnsupportedFileTypeError
nodes.summary: ValueError raised for file types the parser cannot load; mapped to HTTP 415.

nodes.name: EmptyDocumentError
nodes.summary: ValueError raised when a file yields no extractable text or no chunks; mapped to HTTP 422.

nodes.name: DocumentParseError
nodes.summary: ValueError raised when a file is corrupt, encrypted or undecodable; mapped to HTTP 422.

nodes.name: test_real_embeddings.py
nodes.summary: Slow integration tests that index the sample T2D and NSCLC protocols with the real MiniLM embedding model and check retrieval relevance, off-topic abstention without an LLM, and exact-match rescue of short acronym queries.

nodes.name: real_chain
nodes.summary: Module-scoped fixture that indexes the sample protocols into a temporary Chroma store with real embeddings and returns an EligibilityRAGChain without an LLM.

nodes.name: test_kidney_question_retrieves_egfr_exclusion
nodes.summary: Checks that a kidney-function question retrieves the eGFR exclusion chunk scoped to the T2D protocol.

nodes.name: test_short_acronym_query_passes_the_gate_via_exact_match
nodes.summary: Checks that a short acronym query below the dense relevance threshold is rescued by exact code matching.

nodes.name: run_eval.py
nodes.summary: Offline evaluation harness that indexes the sample protocols, compares dense vs hybrid retrieval (hit rate, MRR, abstention-gate sweep) against a golden set, and optionally runs end-to-end LLM answers, writing a Markdown report and enforcing a CI hit-rate floor.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a @dataclass for per-case results and a lazy in-function import of get_llm so the OpenAI/Ollama stack is only loaded with --with-llm.

nodes.name: CaseResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass holding one golden-set case's retrieval outcome: first-hit rank, top dense relevance, code-match flag, contamination and retrieved counts.

nodes.name: load_cases
nodes.summary: Loads golden evaluation cases from the JSONL golden set, skipping blank lines.

nodes.name: build_chain
nodes.summary: Builds a vector store and indexer, parses and splits every sample NCT protocol, indexes the chunks and returns an EligibilityRAGChain for evaluation.

nodes.name: evaluate_retrieval
nodes.summary: Runs retrieval for each case with the gate disabled and records the rank of the first chunk containing an expected keyword plus cross-protocol contamination.

nodes.name: hit_rate
nodes.summary: Computes the fraction of cases whose expected keyword was retrieved.

nodes.name: mrr
nodes.summary: Computes mean reciprocal rank over case results.

nodes.name: retrieval_report
nodes.summary: Renders Markdown tables comparing dense and hybrid retrieval hit rate and MRR per case kind, and sweeps abstention-gate thresholds to show answered vs blocked rates.

nodes.name: llm_report
nodes.summary: Runs end-to-end queries with a real LLM via get_llm and reports status accuracy, abstention and citation verification per case.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point that parses arguments, evaluates both retrieval modes in a temporary Chroma directory, optionally runs the LLM report, writes results.md and exits non-zero below the hit-rate floor.

nodes.name: dependencies.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI dependency providers that build and cache the Chroma vector store, the chosen LLM client (OpenAI or local Ollama), the protocol indexer and the EligibilityRAGChain; tests override them via dependency_overrides.
nodes.languageNotes: functools.lru_cache keyed on primitive settings values provides process-wide singletons, while FastAPI Depends chains the providers together.

nodes.name: _cached_vector_store
nodes.summary: lru_cache-backed builder of the Chroma vector store for a given persist directory and collection.

nodes.name: get_vector_store
nodes.summary: FastAPI dependency returning the cached Chroma store for the current settings.

nodes.name: _cached_llm
nodes.summary: Cached factory for a ChatOpenAI client with deterministic temperature/seed, timeout, retries and output-token cap; imports langchain_openai lazily.

nodes.name: _cached_ollama
nodes.summary: Cached factory for a local ChatOllama client with explicit context window, output cap and timeout; imports langchain_ollama lazily.

nodes.name: get_llm
nodes.summary: Single point of LLM provider selection: returns an Ollama client, an OpenAI client, or None when OpenAI has no API key so indexing and abstentions still work.

nodes.name: get_indexer
nodes.summary: FastAPI dependency wrapping the vector store in a ProtocolIndexer.

nodes.name: get_rag_chain

nodes.summary: Lazily loads and caches the local HuggingFace sentence-transformers embedding model on CPU with L2-normalised vectors, shared by the vector store.

nodes.name: get_embeddings

nodes.name: test_dependencies.py

nodes.name: _settings

nodes.name: chain.py
nodes.summary: Core eligibility RAG pipeline: protocol-scoped dense or hybrid (BM25 + RRF) retrieval, a relevance gate that abstains without the LLM, structured LLM output, verbatim quote verification, and per-criterion patient screening aggregated into an eligibility verdict with audit metadata.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a TypeVar-generic batching generator with the walrus operator and itertools.islice, and LangChain with_structured_output to bind Pydantic schemas to the LLM.

nodes.name: RetrievalResult
nodes.summary: Dataclass carrying retrieved chunks, best dense relevance for the abstention gate, retrieval mode and the hybrid code-match flag.

nodes.name: ProtocolNotFoundError
nodes.summary: LookupError raised when no chunks are indexed for the requested protocol_id.

nodes.name: NoCriteriaError
nodes.summary: LookupError raised when a protocol is indexed but has no detected inclusion/exclusion criteria.

nodes.name: LLMNotConfiguredError
nodes.summary: RuntimeError raised when an LLM call is required but no LLM is configured.

nodes.name: LLMInvocationError
nodes.summary: RuntimeError wrapping LLM call failures or outputs that do not match the expected schema.

nodes.name: _batched
nodes.summary: Generic generator yielding fixed-size lists from an iterable, used to batch screening criteria.

nodes.name: aggregate_screening
nodes.summary: Combines per-criterion verdicts into an overall status: not eligible if any exclusion is met or inclusion not met, indeterminate if any are unresolved, otherwise eligible.

nodes.name: render_assessment
nodes.summary: Renders the STATUS / PROTOCOL EVIDENCE / SAFETY CONCERNS text report from structured status, citations and concerns.

nodes.name: EligibilityRAGChain
nodes.summary: Orchestrates protocol-scoped retrieval (dense or BM25+RRF hybrid), relevance-gated abstention, structured LLM Q&A and batched per-criterion screening with quote verification, eligibility downgrades, audit info and hashed logging.

nodes.name: hybrid.py
nodes.summary: Pure-Python keyword retrieval for hybrid search: a tokenizer with stopwords and light plural stemming, code/acronym term detection, an in-memory Okapi BM25 ranker, and Reciprocal Rank Fusion of ranked ID lists.
nodes.languageNotes: Precompiled regexes and collections.Counter implement BM25 with the '+1' IDF variant to keep IDF positive.

nodes.name: tokenize
nodes.summary: Lowercases text into word tokens, drops stopwords and applies a light plural stem.

nodes.name: code_terms
nodes.summary: Extracts code and acronym tokens (e.g. CYP3A4, ULN) from a query, ignoring pure numbers and NCT trial IDs.

nodes.name: BM25
nodes.summary: In-memory Okapi BM25 ranker over one protocol's chunks with term presence check, per-document scoring and top-N ranking.

nodes.name: reciprocal_rank_fusion
nodes.summary: Merges ranked ID lists by summing 1/(k + rank), preserving first-seen order on ties.

nodes.name: test_hybrid.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the hybrid retrieval helpers covering tokenization, code-term extraction (parametrized), BM25 exact-term ranking and rare-term preference, and Reciprocal Rank Fusion ordering.
nodes.languageNotes: pytest.mark.parametrize drives table-style cases for code_terms.

nodes.name: test_tokenize_lowercases_drops_stopwords_and_stems_plurals
nodes.summary: Verifies tokenize lowercases, removes stopwords, stems plurals and keeps -ss words intact.

nodes.name: test_code_terms
nodes.summary: Parametrized test of code/acronym extraction including numbers and NCT IDs being ignored.

nodes.name: test_bm25_ranks_exact_term_first_and_skips_non_matches
nodes.summary: Checks BM25 ranks the exact-term document first, omits zero scores and reports term presence.

nodes.name: test_bm25_prefers_rarer_terms
nodes.summary: Checks BM25 scores rarer terms higher via IDF.

nodes.name: test_reciprocal_rank_fusion
nodes.summary: Checks RRF ordering of items appearing across multiple rankings.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Docker build-context exclusion list that keeps secrets (.env), local data stores, tests, eval, scripts, docs and CI files out of the image, re-including only .env.example and README.md.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Two-stage Docker build that creates a virtualenv with CPU-only torch and bakes the MiniLM embedding model, then ships a slim non-root runtime serving app:app with uvicorn on port 8000 behind a /health HEALTHCHECK.
nodes.languageNotes: Multi-stage build: the builder stage installs dependencies and pre-downloads the Hugging Face model, and the runtime stage copies only /opt/venv and the HF cache, running offline (HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1) with a single worker because the embedded Chroma store is single-process.

nodes.name: builder
nodes.summary: Build stage on python:3.11-slim that creates /opt/venv, installs CPU-only torch and requirements.txt, and pre-downloads the sentence-transformers embedding model into /opt/hf-cache.

nodes.name: runtime
nodes.summary: Slim runtime stage that copies the venv and model cache from builder, adds app.py and src/, runs as the non-root user gskapp, exposes port 8000 and starts uvicorn with one worker.

nodes.name: ci.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow triggered on pushes to main and pull requests: a test job runs ruff, mypy, offline pytest, slow real-embedding tests and the retrieval eval with a 0.95 hit-rate floor (uploading eval/results.md), then a docker job builds the image without pushing.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `needs: test` to gate the Docker build on the test job, and caches both pip downloads and the Hugging Face model directory to keep runs fast.

nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Template environment file defining the runtime settings: LLM provider choice (OpenAI or local Ollama/Qwen) with model, temperature, seed and token caps, plus embedding model, Chroma persistence, upload limits, chunking, retrieval top-k, relevance gate and log level.

layers.name: API Layer
layers.description: FastAPI application entry point (app.py with request-ID/latency middleware and error handlers) plus the /api/v1 routers for protocol upload, criterion Q&A and patient screening, and the Depends() providers that build the Chroma store, LLM client and RAG chain.

layers.name: Configuration & Schemas
layers.description: Shared foundation imported by every other layer: pydantic-settings configuration, Pydantic v2 request/response models with citation and audit types, the package version, plus environment template, pyproject tooling config and pinned dependency lists.

layers.name: Ingestion Pipeline
layers.description: Protocol ingestion flow (parse -> split -> index) that loads PDF/TXT protocols, chunks them into criterion-level inclusion/exclusion chunks, and persists them into ChromaDB with protocol-scoped idempotent replacement.

layers.name: RAG Service Layer

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to see what clinical-trial-rag does: a FastAPI microservice that answers eligibility questions about trial protocols and pre-screens a patient summary against every criterion, with answers grounded in verbatim, verified protocol text. Its core design principle is that the LLM only reads text and fills a typed form, while code handles trial isolation, hybrid retrieval, abstention, quote verification and the final eligibility decision. The Mermaid diagram of the Ingestion, Query and Screening flows is the map for the rest of this tour, and the study book goes deeper into every concept and file.

tour.title: Configuration and Dependencies
tour.description: Every layer builds on a shared foundation, so it comes first. src/config.py is a pydantic-settings model that loads storage paths, embedding and LLM provider options (OpenAI or local Ollama), chunking, hybrid retrieval and relevance-gate parameters from the environment or a .env file, and exposes them through a cached get_settings(). .env.example lists every one of those knobs, and requirements.txt pins the stack: FastAPI, Pydantic v2, LangChain integrations, chromadb and sentence-transformers.
tour.languageLesson: pydantic-settings' BaseSettings maps environment variables onto typed fields and validates them, so bad configuration fails at startup rather than mid-request. Wrapping the getter in functools.lru_cache turns it into a cheap process-wide singleton that tests can still reset or override.

tour.title: Typed Contracts and Schemas
tour.description: src/schemas.py is one of the most imported files in the project. It defines the Pydantic v2 request and response models for queries, screening, citations and the audit block, plus the length-bounded structured-output schemas the LLM must fill for Q&A and per-criterion screening. This is the "typed form" from Step 1: because the model can only return these shapes, everything downstream can check its answers deterministically.
tour.languageLesson: Pydantic v2 models can forbid unknown fields (extra='forbid'), add length and range constraints with Field(), and enforce patterns such as NCT IDs. Passing the same model to LangChain's with_structured_output means the LLM output is parsed and validated exactly like an API request body.

tour.title: Application Entry Point
tour.description: app.py is the ASGI entry point that uvicorn serves. It configures logging on startup, adds middleware that attaches a request ID and measures latency, maps domain exceptions from the parser and RAG chain to HTTP status codes, and mounts the health and protocol routers. Read it as the outline of the request lifecycle before going into the routers it wires together.
tour.languageLesson: FastAPI's @app.exception_handler lets you raise plain domain exceptions deep in the service code and translate them to HTTP responses in one place, which keeps business logic free of HTTP concerns.

tour.title: HTTP Routes and Dependency Injection
tour.description: routes.py defines liveness and readiness probes plus the /api/v1 endpoints that upload and index protocols, answer criterion questions, screen patients, and list or delete protocols. It also handles upload safety: filename sanitization, a PDF magic-byte check, size-limited staging and atomic replacement. Routes get their collaborators from dependencies.py, which builds and caches the Chroma vector store, the chosen LLM client (OpenAI or Ollama), the indexer and the EligibilityRAGChain. That indirection is what lets tests swap in fakes later.
tour.languageLesson: FastAPI's Depends() resolves function parameters by calling provider functions. Because providers are looked up by identity, app.dependency_overrides[get_chain] = fake_factory replaces a real dependency with a test double without changing any route code.

tour.title: Ingestion: Parse and Split
tour.description: The first half of the Ingestion flow turns an uploaded file into criterion-level chunks. parser.py loads .pdf and .txt protocols into LangChain Documents, with encoding fallbacks and typed errors for unsupported, empty or unparseable files. splitter.py, one of the most-imported files in the project, detects section headers, labels inclusion and exclusion sections, emits one chunk per top-level criterion, and prefixes each chunk with protocol and section context so it still makes sense when retrieved alone.

tour.title: Indexing into ChromaDB
tour.description: indexer.py finishes ingestion: ingest_file runs parse, split and index, and stores the chunks from Step 6 in ChromaDB with protocol-scoped, idempotent replacement (delete-then-add by protocol_id), so re-uploading a protocol replaces the old version cleanly. It also provides the reads that later steps rely on: chunks, every criterion of a trial for screening, and protocol summaries. Vectors come from embeddings.py, which lazily loads and caches a local sentence-transformers MiniLM model on CPU with L2-normalised output.

tour.title: Hybrid Retrieval with BM25
tour.description: Dense embeddings alone can miss short codes and acronyms, so hybrid.py adds a pure-Python keyword path: a tokenizer with stopwords and light plural stemming, code and acronym term detection, an in-memory Okapi BM25 ranker, and Reciprocal Rank Fusion to merge the dense and keyword rankings. This is the "dense + BM25, fused with RRF" box in the README's Query flow, and the exact-code detection is what lets the relevance gate accept an exact match even when dense similarity is low.

tour.title: Prompts and Guardrails
tour.description: Before and after the LLM call, two modules keep the model on a short leash. prompt_templates.py holds versioned LangChain ChatPromptTemplates for Q&A and screening, and renders retrieved chunks as sanitised, attributed XML-like blocks with short I1/E1 labels. guardrails.py contains the deterministic checks: it strips prompt-delimiter tags from context to resist prompt injection, verifies that LLM quotes appear verbatim in the source, checks that evidence is relevant to a criterion, and hashes text for privacy-safe logging.

tour.title: The Eligibility RAG Chain
tour.description: chain.py is where every previous piece comes together, and it has the widest reach of any source module. For a question, it runs protocol-scoped dense or hybrid retrieval (Step 8), applies a relevance gate that returns the fixed "criteria not specified" fallback without calling the LLM, requests structured output against the schemas from Step 3, and verifies quotes with the guardrails from Step 9, downgrading anything it cannot verify. For screening, it fetches all criteria from the indexer, gets a verdict per criterion, and computes eligibility in code (all inclusions met and no exclusions), attaching audit metadata such as model, prompt version and context hash.

tour.title: Sample Protocols and Data
tour.description: The service ships with two synthetic protocols that tests and evaluation run against: a Phase 3 type 2 diabetes trial with numbered criteria and a Phase 2 NSCLC trial with bulleted criteria, which exercise both list formats the splitter from Step 6 has to handle. To try real trials, scripts/fetch_ctgov.py downloads eligibility criteria from the ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 and writes a .txt file with the Inclusion/Exclusion markers the splitter expects, saved by default under data/raw_protocols/.

tour.title: Testing with Fakes
tour.description: The pytest suite checks the pipeline without network access or a real model. conftest.py provides isolated temp Chroma storage, deterministic fake embeddings, a fake structured-output LLM and a TestClient that uses the dependency overrides from Step 5. test_chain.py covers abstention, citation verification and screening aggregation, test_endpoints.py drives the full HTTP surface (including path safety and prompt-injection resistance), and the slow test_real_embeddings.py checks retrieval quality and acronym rescue with the real MiniLM model.
tour.languageLesson: pytest fixtures defined in conftest.py are discovered automatically by every test in that directory tree. Combined with custom markers (here, 'slow', skipped by default via pyproject.toml addopts), one suite can hold fast offline tests and heavier model-backed tests.

tour.title: Offline Retrieval Evaluation
tour.description: Tests show the code is correct; the evaluation harness measures how well retrieval works. run_eval.py indexes the sample protocols from Step 11, compares dense and hybrid retrieval on a 35-case golden set (lookup, exact and abstain questions with expected keywords) using hit rate, MRR and a relevance-gate threshold sweep, and optionally runs end-to-end LLM answers. It writes Markdown reports such as results.md, and the qwen2.5:7b report records a local Ollama run with zero unsafe answers and perfect citation verification.

tour.title: Container Build and CI
tour.description: The Dockerfile packages the service in two stages: a builder that creates a virtualenv with CPU-only torch and bakes in the MiniLM model from Step 7, and a slim runtime that runs as a non-root user and serves app:app with uvicorn on port 8000 behind a /health HEALTHCHECK. .dockerignore keeps secrets, data, tests and docs out of the build context. The GitHub Actions workflow ties everything together: ruff, mypy, offline pytest, the slow embedding tests and the retrieval eval with a 0.95 hit-rate floor, then a Docker image build.
tour.languageLesson: Baking the embedding model into the builder stage and copying only the venv and model cache into the runtime stage means containers start without downloading anything and the final image carries no build tooling. In CI, making the eval script fail below a hit-rate floor turns a quality metric into a merge gate.
